Imou Ranger Mini 3MP 2K Pan & Tilt Portable Wi-Fi Camera

The Imou Ranger Mini 3MP 2K Pan & Tilt Portable Wi-Fi Camera is a compact, high-performance security camera ideal for home or office use. Featuring a 1/3” Progressive CMOS sensor with 3MP resolution, it records clear videos at 2304x1296 (2K) and up to 20fps. Its 3.6mm fixed lens offers a wide field of view (79° H, 43° V, 94° D), while 355° pan and -5~50° tilt ensure nearly complete coverage. Smart alerts include motion detection, human detection, configurable regions, and abnormal sound alarms. Storage is flexible with a micro SD card slot (up to 512GB), and connectivity supports Wi-Fi 6 and 100Mbps Ethernet. Efficient H.265/H.264 compression optimizes storage. Compact and lightweight (95 × 96 × 109.2 mm, 200g), the Imou Ranger Mini Wi-Fi Camera works in -10°C to +45°C environments with <95% humidity, powered by DC 5V 1A (<4.2W). With USB-C support, remote pan & tilt control, and CE certification, the Imou Ranger Mini Camera delivers smart, reliable surveillance in a portable design.

The Resolution That Best Suits Your Needs

The Imou Ranger Mini delivers crisp 2K images with its 3-megapixel sensor, ensuring every detail is captured clearly. To meet different surveillance needs, the Ranger Mini offers two camera pixel options, allowing you to select the resolution that best fits your space and monitoring requirements. Whether you want high-definition clarity for detailed indoor monitoring or a standard option for general coverage, Imou Ranger Mini provides flexible image quality to suit your home or office security needs.

Mini but Powerful, with Integrated Bracket Mounting

The Imou Ranger Mini combines compact size with powerful functionality. Thanks to its integrated bracket, this camera can be easily installed on a wall, ceiling, or simply placed on a table, eliminating the need for additional accessories. Its versatile mounting options make setup quick and hassle-free, fitting seamlessly into any room or office space.

Remotely Pan & Tilt for 360° Protection

Despite its small size, the Ranger Mini provides full coverage with 0°–355° pan and -5°–50° tilt, allowing you to monitor your surroundings with a true 360-degree view. You can adjust the camera remotely via the Imou App, ensuring every corner of your home or office is protected. This combination of compact design, flexible installation, and full-range pan & tilt makes the Imou Ranger Mini an ideal solution for complete, reliable security.

Light the Night Up with Smartness

The Imou Ranger Mini offers flexible night vision modes to match your needs, ensuring clear surveillance even in complete darkness. In Smart Mode, the camera automatically switches from infrared to full-color mode whenever suspicious motion is detected, providing instant, detailed footage only when necessary. The Full-Color Mode utilizes built-in spotlights to deliver vibrant, full-color night vision, making every corner visible even at night. For traditional black-and-white monitoring, Infrared Mode uses an advanced IR algorithm to produce clear, high-contrast images in complete darkness. If you prefer to save energy or disable night vision, the Off Mode turns off all infrared and spotlight functions, giving you complete control over your camera’s operation. With these intelligent options, the Imou Ranger Mini ensures your home stays secure while adapting its night vision to your exact requirements.

Connect Home from Anywhere and Deters Unwelcome Visitors

With the Imou Ranger Mini, you can connect to your home from anywhere. The camera supports full-duplex two-way talk with built-in echo cancellation, enabling smooth, real-time communication with anyone in front of the camera through the Imou App. Beyond communication, it actively deters unwelcome visitors when motion or intrusion is detected, the built-in siren automatically activates to alert and discourage intruders. Even when you’re away, the Ranger Mini keeps your home secure and under constant watch, providing peace of mind with intelligent monitoring features.

The Dahua DH-IPC-HFW1230TL2-S5 2MP Bullet IP Camera is a high-performance surveillance system built for dependable, high-definition video monitoring in a variety of scenarios. The DH-IPC-HFW1230TL2-S5 has superior detecting capabilities that improve security measures. It includes motion detection to detect unusual activity, video tampering alerts to detect any attempts to obstruct the camera, network disconnection and IP conflict detection to ensure reliable connections, and illegal access detection to notify you of unauthorized camera access. The camera accepts both 12 VDC and PoE (Power over Ethernet) power supply, allowing for simple setup and integration into existing network systems. The camera's IP67 classification assures that it is dust-tight and water-resistant, allowing it to work reliably in harsh weather and outdoor locations. Description

EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Channel Wireless NVR

The EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Channel Wireless NVR is an advanced surveillance solution that combines high-definition video recording, wireless convenience, and expandable storage. This innovative EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Channel NVR can accommodate up to 8 channels of 5MP IP cameras, providing crystal-clear video and outstanding monitoring coverage. The device supports both HDMI (2560×1440 at 30Hz) and VGA (1920×1080 at 60Hz) outputs, providing many display options for live viewing and playback. Equipped with H.265 and H.264 decoding capabilities, the EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W NVR ensures efficient compression, faster streaming, and maximized storage capacity without compromising image quality. Users can record in various modes, including manual, motion detection, scheduled, and event-triggered recording, allowing customized and responsive surveillance setups. This powerful EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Ch NVR features a built-in SATA interface that supports 3.5-inch HDDs from 1TB up to 8TB, ensuring long-term footage retention and secure data storage. Playback is enhanced with synchronized 8-channel viewing and multiple options like instant playback, tag playback, event playback, and log-based playback, making it easy to find specific incidents. Wireless performance is a standout feature of the EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Channel Wireless NVR, with dual antennas, 2.4GHz radio frequency, and a 100-meter maximum wireless range, enabling seamless connection with up to 8 wireless 5MP cameras without the hassle of cabling. The NVR also includes one 10/100M Ethernet port and a USB 2.0 port for backup and auxiliary use. Compact and lightweight at ≤900g with dimensions of 235mm x 270mm x 44.5mm, the EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W 8 Channel NVR is built for easy integration into any home or office security setup. Open protocol support ensures compatibility with third-party devices and systems, enhancing flexibility and scalability. Whether for residential, commercial, or industrial use, the EZVIZ CS-X5S-8W NVR offers a robust, wireless, and high-capacity solution for modern video surveillance needs.

Tenda CH9-WCA 6MP Dual-lens Smart Outdoor Pan & Tilt WiFi Camera

The Tenda CH9-WCA The 6MP Dual-Lens Smart Outdoor Pan & Tilt WiFi Camera is a modern safety solution with a dual-lens system that provides improved coverage and accuracy. The camera has a 1/3 Progressive Scan CMOS sensor with 6MP resolution, resulting in clear and detailed pictures for both day and night monitoring. The Tenda CH9-WCA 6MP Outdoor WiFi Camera's fixed and PT lenses allow it to watch two separate regions at the same time, considerably decreasing blind zones. The fixed lens has an 82.3° horizontal field of view (FOV), and the PT lens has a smaller 51.8° FOV, allowing for more flexible monitoring. The Tenda CH9-WCA 6MP Security WiFi Camera, which comes with 6 infrared lights and 6 high-power spotlights, provides spectacular, full-color night vision in Full Color Mode, as well as Smart Full Color Mode, which instantly converts to color when motion detects. It also has an Infrared Mode for black-and-white images when the spotlights are turned off. To reduce false alarms, the camera includes powerful AI recognition features such as person, vehicle, motion, line crossing, and intrusion detection. With a broad variety of configurable settings, including pan movement from 0° to 260° and tilt movement from 0° to 90°, the Tenda CH9-WCA 6MP WiFi IP Camera provides 360° rotating coverage and preset patrol choices for complete monitoring. The Tenda CH9-WCA IP Camera also integrates Wi-Fi 6 technology for stable and smooth video streaming, with a transmission rate of up to 287Mbps. It features dual audio communication with a built-in mic and speaker, as well as smart alerts with both sound and light to deter intruders. For storage, the Tenda CH9-WCA WiFi Camera supports microSD cards up to 512GB, allowing for extensive recording. With its IP65 weatherproof rating, the Tenda Outdoor Security Camera performs flawlessly in temperatures ranging from -30°C to 60°C (-22°F to 140°F). Whether mounted on a wall, ceiling, or pole, the Tenda CH9-WCA is a top choice for anyone looking for reliable, high-performance outdoor security.

Pan/Tilt Capabilities

The Tenda CH9-WCA is ideal for round-the-clock surveillance because it has two infrared lights and two spotlights. This IP Camera can see up to 30 meters (98 feet) in the dark. The smooth transition between lighting conditions is ensured by the ICR-type day and night shift mode.

Night Vision

The Tenda CH9-WCA is suitable for 24-hour monitoring since it has two infrared lights and two spotlights. This IP Camera can see for up to 30 meters (98 ft) in the dark. The ICR day and night shift mode ensures a seamless transition between illumination situations.

Dual Lenses AI Detection

The Tenda CH9-WCA IP Camera features advanced AI-powered detection with dual lenses and deep-learning algorithms, accurately identifying humans and vehicles while minimizing false alarms. Powered by a Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and a high-performance System on Chip (SOC), this camera efficiently processes real-time data, ensuring reliable and precise security monitoring. The Tenda CH9-WCA stands out for its ability to distinguish relevant activity, offering smarter, more accurate surveillance and enhanced peace of mind for home security.

Description

Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU 6MP Smart Hybrid Light Dome IP Camera

The Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU is a 6MP smart hybrid light dome IP camera designed to provide high-resolution surveillance and intelligent security monitoring. Featuring a 1/2.4" progressive scan CMOS sensor, it produces crystal-clear imaging at a maximum resolution of 3200 × 1800. It also supports human and vehicle detection through powerful smart analytics. The Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU Dome IP Camera has a range of up to 30 meters and employs hybrid IR and white light lighting, as well as a smart supplement light system, to provide effective day and night performance. Its fixed lens is available in 2.8mm or 4mm sizes, offering large fields of view, and the lens mount is an M12 fitting with a fixed iris and F1.6 aperture. The Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU 6MP Smart Hybrid Light Dome IP Camera provides crisp video in a variety of lighting circumstances, thanks to features such as up to 120 dB wide dynamic range, 3D DNR, BLC, and HLC image improvement. It supports H.265+ video compression, which reduces bandwidth while maintaining image quality, and has a scalable bit rate of 32 Kbps to 16 Mbps. Audio is provided by a built-in microphone with noise filtering and compatibility with numerous audio codecs, including G.711, G.722.1, and AAC-LC. The Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU 6MP IP Camera supports TCP/IP, RTSP, FTP, and IPv6, and security features include password protection, watermarking, and authentication protocols. An optional microSD slot allows you to expand the onboard storage up to 512 GB. The Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU 6MP Smart Hybrid Light Dome IP Camera is rated IP67 for water and dust resistance and IK08 for vandalism protection. It offers simultaneous live watching on up to six channels and can be controlled via the Hik-Connect app, the iVMS-4200, or common browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. Motion detection, event linkage to FTP or email, and up to four zones of privacy masking are among the additional features. This Hikvision DS-2CD1163G2-LIU 6MP Smart Hybrid Light Dome IP Camera is a dependable and versatile choice for professional indoor and outdoor surveillance.

Hikvision DS-2CD1T67G3-LIU 6MP ColorVu Fixed Bullet Network IP Camera

The Hikvision DS-2CD1T67G3-LIU 6MP ColorVu Fixed Bullet Network IP Camera is a PoE-powered outdoor security camera for homes, shops, offices, and commercial properties that need sharp, full-color surveillance day and night. This Hikvision 6MP ColorVu Camera uses a 1/2.4" progressive scan CMOS sensor to capture video at up to 3200 × 1800 resolution, with a fast F1.0 aperture that gathers more light for clear color images in low-light conditions. With a built-in microphone and an IP67 water and dust resistant housing, the Hikvision ColorVu Bullet Camera is built for reliable monitoring of entrances, driveways, parking areas, yards, and storefronts.

ColorVu Night Vision with IR and White Light Up to 50 m

The Hikvision DS-2CD1T67G3-LIU offers a minimum illumination of 0.0005 Lux (color, F1.0, AGC on) and 0 Lux with supplement light, so it keeps recording usable color footage in very dark scenes. Dual supplement lighting with IR (850 nm) and white light reaches up to 50 m, and the smart supplement light feature helps adjust the lighting to the scene. A choice of Day, Night, Auto, and Schedule modes and an IR cut filter give you flexible control over day and night switching, making this Hikvision IP Camera a dependable option for 24/7 surveillance.

6MP Image Quality with 120 dB WDR and Lens Options

The Hikvision 6MP Network Camera records up to 20 fps at 3200 × 1800, 2688 × 1520, 1920 × 1080, and 1280 × 720 in the main stream, with H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 compression to help reduce bandwidth and storage use. 120 dB wide dynamic range, BLC, HLC, and 3D DNR keep images clear in high-contrast scenes such as backlit doorways, while an SNR of 52 dB or more supports clean video. The camera is available with a 2.8 mm lens (109° horizontal field of view) for wide coverage or a 4 mm lens (89° horizontal field of view) for a more focused view. 4 programmable privacy masks and a region of interest for the main stream add control over what is monitored and how it is recorded.

Flexible Installation, PoE Power, and Built-in Audio

The fixed bullet design supports adjustable angles, with pan from 0° to 355°, tilt from 0° to 180°, and rotation from 0° to 355°, so it can be mounted on walls or ceilings and aimed where it is needed. The Hikvision DS-2CD1T67G3-LIU supports PoE (IEEE 802.3at, Class 4, max. 15 W) through a single RJ45 10M/100M Ethernet port, and it also accepts 12 VDC power with reverse polarity protection. A built-in microphone with environment noise filtering and support for G.711, G.722.1, G.726, MP2L2, PCM, and AAC-LC audio compression adds sound to your recordings.

Ezviz CS-DP2C Smart Video Doorbell

The Ezviz CS-DP2C Wire-Free Peephole Smart Video Doorbell is a home security solution designed for modern households seeking convenience, clarity, and control. Engineered to fit a wide range of door types—with supported peephole diameters from 16.5 to 50 mm and door thicknesses between 35 to 105 mm—this smart doorbell offers hassle-free installation and a sleek, wire-free design. At its core is a powerful 1/3" progressive scan CMOS sensor paired with a 2.0 mm lens that delivers a stunning 1080p Full HD resolution at 15fps. The doorbell operates on a secure 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection and supports multiple encryption protocols, including WPA/WPA2 and WPS, ensuring safe and stable data transmission. With intuitive buttons for doorbell activation, power control, and screen wake-up, the CS-DP2C is designed for effortless operation. Though it doesn’t support face detection, its robust PIR-based intelligence alarm system ensures reliable motion-triggered alerts. Whether you're upgrading your home security system or looking for a smart, wire-free alternative to traditional peepholes, the Ezviz CS-DP2C offers a feature-rich, user-friendly experience that combines high-definition video, smart motion detection, and secure connectivity—all in one sleek package.

Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G 2K Pan & Tilt Solar Camera

The Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G is a 4G solar security camera with a 2304 × 1296 sensor. It combines pan-tilt coverage, warm-light night illumination, and human and vehicle detection. A 10000 mAh battery and an 8 W solar panel keep it running without a power outlet. IP66 protection suits outdoor use. This 4G LTE security IP Camera fits farms, shops, construction sites, and homes with no Wi-Fi.

2K Video Recording & Smart Storage

The Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G features a 1/2.9-inch CMOS sensor with a maximum resolution of 2304 × 1296 pixels. It records at 1–15 fps at full resolution and uses H.265 video compression to reduce storage requirements. The video bit rate ranges from 32 kbps to 4096 kbps, while WDR helps balance bright and dark areas in a scene. A MicroSD card slot supports up to 512 GB of local storage. The DMSS app, available for iOS and Android, supports live viewing, playback, and camera settings management, allowing users to access camera footage remotely.

Lens and Field of View

A fixed 3.6 mm lens with a maximum aperture of F1.0 captures light well. The field of view measures 81° horizontal, 44° vertical, and 95° diagonal. Wide coverage helps the camera watch large outdoor areas. Fewer cameras are needed to cover one site. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G outdoor security camera suits driveways, warehouses, and open compounds.

360° Pan and Tilt Coverage

Pan range spans 0° to 350°, and tilt range spans 0° to 90°. Together, these ranges give 360° view coverage without blind spots. One camera can watch several directions and replace multiple fixed units. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G pan tilt camera helps users check every corner of a property. Remote control through the app makes viewing simple and flexible.

Warm-Light Night Vision and WizColor

Four warm-light illuminators light up the scene up to 20 m away. WizColor technology supports clear, colorful images in low light. Colors help users spot clothing, vehicles, and other details at night. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G night vision security camera improves evidence quality after dark. Warm light also stays less harsh than white floodlights on a property.

Human and Vehicle Detection

Human detection and vehicle detection help the camera focus on real threats. Motion detection works with on/off control and 4 rectangular areas. Users can mark key zones and cut down on unwanted alerts. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G smart security camera sends alerts that matter. Property owners can respond faster to people and vehicles entering the site.

Two-Way Audio

A built-in microphone and speaker support two-way audio. Users can listen to the scene and speak through the camera in real time. Audio compression supports G.711a, G.711Mu, and PCM. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G two-way audio camera helps greet visitors, warn intruders, or guide staff. Communication happens from anywhere through a phone.

4G LTE and Ethernet Connectivity

The camera connects through 4G LTE or RJ-45 Ethernet. FDD bands include B1, B3, B5, B7, B8, B20, and B28. TDD bands include B38, B40, and B41. Transmit power measures 23 dBm ± 2.7 dB. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G 4G camera works where Wi-Fi is weak or missing. Remote sites stay online through a mobile network.

Battery and Solar Power

A 10000 mAh, 36 Wh battery powers the camera, and an 8 W monocrystalline silicon solar panel recharges it. USB power input is 5 V DC ± 5% at 2 A. Performance Mode uses 1.22 W, AOV Mode uses 0.08 W, and Ultra Power Saving Mode uses 0.008 W. AOV Mode supports 24/7 recording with ultra-low power use. This Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G solar powered CCTV camera suits sites without mains power.

IP66 Protection & Durable Design

The Dahua APOLLO BP3EW-4G features a plastic casing with an IP66 rating for dust and water protection, making it suitable for outdoor use. It operates at temperatures from −20°C to +50°C with humidity up to 95% RH, non-condensing. The battery supports charging at 0°C to +50°C and discharging at −20°C to +60°C. Reset and Power buttons are located on the camera body. The solar camera also lists CE-LVD, CE-EMC, and CE-RED certifications.

The Hikvision DS-K3B220X-R/M Swinging Barrier Gate also has dual lock control, an exit button, and alarm input and output for further security. It can hold up to 200,000 card credentials and 250,000 event records, making it ideal for high-traffic situations. Hikvision DS-K3Y220X-L1/MPg-Dp55 Flap Barrier Gate

The Hikvision DS-K3Y220X-L1/MPg-Dp55 Flap Barrier Gate features a long-lasting brushless motor with a mean cycle between failures (MCBF) of over 3 million operations. It has a card capacity of up to 200,000 and an event capacity of 250,000, making it perfect for heavy traffic locations. The system contains a built-in access controller with authentication options for EM and M1 cards, as well as optional facial recognition integration. The Hikvision DS-K3Y220X-L1/MPg-Dp55 Barrier Gate is equipped with four pairs of infrared light detectors and anti-tailgating capability to effectively prevent unwanted entrance. The lane width options range from 650mm (25.6 inches) to 900mm (35.4 inches), providing versatility for a variety of access control needs. The pedestrian throughput rate ranges from 20 to 60 people per minute, depending on the passing speed and manner. The gate, built with SUS304 stainless steel pedestals and acrylic glass barriers, combines strength and modern aesthetics. The Hikvision DS-K3Y220X-L1/MPg-Dp55 Flap Barrier Gate is designed for user ease, with an LED light indicator to guide passing direction and valid passage duration settings that cancel access if an individual does not pass within a certain time. Safety measures include automatic door opening in the event of a fire alarm, allowing for uninterrupted escape. The Hikvision Flap Barrier Gate also includes remote control keyfob functionality and an integrated speaker for audio prompts, which are available as optional upgrades. A 10M/100M network interface ensures continuous connectivity, and the Hikvision DS-K3Y220X-L1/MPg-Dp55 Barrier Gate features multiple lock control, exit button, and alarm input/output ports.

Hikvision DS-K3G501LX-R Pro Tripod Turnstile

The Hikvision DS-K3G501LX-R Pro Tripod Turnstile is a reliable and secure access control solution for high-traffic locations. It has several operation modes, including barrier open, closed, free accessing, and banned mode, which provides flexible access control to fulfill a variety of security requirements. This bidirectional turnstile accommodates both entry and exit lanes, making it ideal for regions with significant pedestrian traffic. Hikvision DS-K3G501LX-R Pro Tripod Turnstile features an LED indication that indicates entrance, exit, and passing status to help users navigate quickly. Safety is a primary emphasis, with a fire alarm integration that automatically lowers the barrier for emergency evacuation when the alarm sounds. The system also supports valid passing duration settings, which immediately cancel passing authorization if a person does not pass through within the specified period. The Hikvision DS-K3G501LX-R Pro Tripod Turnstile supports third-party access control systems via a relay input, allowing customers to integrate it into existing security systems. Key buttons allow for offline modifications of functions and parameters, making configuration easy. The Hikvision Tripod Turnstile has an exceptional mean cycle between failures (MCBF) of more than three million cycles, ensuring long-term durability and reliability. With a throughput rate of more than 35 people per minute, it allows for efficient crowd control, while the actual pace is dependent on user behavior and passing techniques. The Hikvision DS-K3G501LX-R Pro Tripod Turnstile's lane width is 550mm, providing a comfortable passage for individuals.

Hikvision DS-K5671-ZU Face Recognition Module For Turnstile

The Hikvision DS-K5671-ZU Face Recognition Module is built specifically for Turnstile. It is a cutting-edge biometric access control device that uses high-accuracy facial recognition to handle entries securely and efficiently. The Hikvision Face Recognition Module, which features a 7-inch LCD capacitive touch screen and a high-resolution 2 MP dual-lens camera, enables fast and precise recognition with a detection distance of 0.3 to 3 meters and an accuracy rate of more than 99%. The gadget can handle up to 50,000 face profiles and 100,000 event logs, making it perfect for high-traffic areas like corporate offices, public buildings, and transportation hubs. The Hikvision DS-K5671-ZU Face Recognition Module's built-in IO and Wiegand outputs enable seamless connection with third-party turnstiles, increasing integration options. The Hikvision Face Recognition Module supports both TCP/IP and Wi-Fi communication, ensuring consistent connectivity, while remote live view is provided via the RTSP protocol. It has an IP65 classification, which means it is resistant to dust and water, ensuring longevity in a variety of environments. The Hikvision DS-K5671-ZU Face Recognition Module features an RJ-45 network interface, lock control, door contact input, two alarm inputs, one alarm output, and an RS-485 interface for added connectivity. It features QR code recognition for alternative authentication methods, allowing users to scan codes with a minimum dimension of 6 cm x 6 cm. With a recognition time of less than 0.2 seconds per user, the Hikvision DS-K5671-ZU Face Recognition Module For Turnstile improves access control efficiency while maintaining high security standards.

Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32 Channel 2U 8K Network Video Recorder (NVR)

The Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32-Channel 2U 8K Network Video Recorder (NVR) is a powerful surveillance system built for large-scale security applications. It supports up to 32 IP camera inputs and has superior video recording capabilities, such as 2-channel 32 MP, 2-channel 24 MP, 4-channel 12 MP, 8-channel 8 MP, 16-channel 4 MP, or 32-channel 1080p decoding capacity. The Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32 Channel NVR has a remarkable incoming bandwidth of 320 Mbps and an outgoing bandwidth of 400 Mbps, allowing for continuous data transmission and fast video streaming. Its powerful streaming technology ensures flawless live watching even under bad network conditions. This Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32 Channel 8K NVR offers superb video output via dual HDMI and VGA interfaces, with 8K resolution or dual 4K video outputs for superior image quality. It is compatible with specialist cameras such as people counting, ANPR (automatic number plate recognition), and fisheye cameras, making it appropriate for a wide range of security applications. The Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32 Channel 2U 8K Network Video Recorder (NVR) supports RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, and 10 configurations, as well as a N+M hot spare feature to improve data security and avoid data loss. It also supports up to eight IP speakers for integrated audio solutions. With H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 decoding formats, the Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 NVR maximizes storage efficiency while preserving high-quality recordings. It offers up to 16 channels of simultaneous playback, allowing you greater flexibility in monitoring and reviewing material. Two RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet interfaces improve network connectivity, as do many supported protocols such as TCP/IP, DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, and ONVIF. The Hikvision DS-9632NI-M8 32 Channel 8K Network Video Recorder has eight hot-plug SATA ports, each of which can hold up to 16 TB of storage, as well as one eSATA interface for further capacity. Its alarm system has 16 inputs, 9 outputs, and a controlled 12VDC power output for external alarm systems.

Imou Ranger Dual Lens 6MP Pan & Tilt WiFi Camera

The Imou Ranger Dual Lens WiFi Camera is a powerful and intelligent indoor security solution, designed to provide complete room coverage, smart detection, and real-time peace of mind. Equipped with two 3MP lenses one pan-tilt lens and one fixed lens this dual-lens system delivers 6MP total resolution (2304 × 1296) and simultaneous monitoring of two zones. While the pan-tilt lens supports full 360° rotation (355° horizontal and 90° vertical), the fixed lens provides wide-angle static coverage, eliminating blind spots and doubling down on security.

Night Vision with Smart Modes

The Ranger Dual ensures optimal visibility in low light with four intelligent night vision modes — including full-color, infrared, smart mode, and off. You can keep night vision in color all the time or set it to activate color only when motion is detected to save energy. It offers clear visuals up to 15 meters even in complete darkness.

IMOU SENSE AI – Faster, Smarter Detection

Powered by the IMOU SENSE AI engine, each lens processes motion detection independently without sacrificing accuracy. This results in a 50% boost in detection performance, recognizing human or pet movement with incredible speed, sending alerts to your phone in just 0.02 seconds. The system also includes abnormal sound detection (like a baby crying or glass breaking), ensuring you're aware of any potential issues instantly.

Smart Tracking & Active Deterrence

Once a person or pet is detected, the camera can intelligently track the moving object while simultaneously triggering a siren and flashing spotlight to deter potential intruders. Notifications are pushed instantly to your mobile device via the Imou app, giving you full control and real-time response.

Two-Way Talk & Privacy Mode

With a built-in microphone and speaker featuring echo cancellation, you can easily talk to family or pets remotely. When you need privacy, the lens can automatically retract with a single tap for peace of mind.

Flexible Storage & Fast Connectivity

Storage is simple and secure, supporting microSD cards up to 256GB, cloud storage, and NVR integration. Thanks to Wi-Fi 6 (IEEE802.11b/g/n/ax) and Ethernet connectivity, the camera offers fast, reliable streaming and remote access. Its compact design (only 225g and 82.2 × 82.2 × 115.4 mm) and low power consumption (<5.65W) make it a discreet yet powerful addition to any smart home.

Hikvision DS-K1T321EFWX Face Recognition Access Control Terminal

The Hikvision DS-K1T321EFWX Face Recognition Access Control Terminal is a cutting-edge security device designed to provide efficient and secure access control solutions. Featuring a 2.4-inch LCD screen and a high-quality 2 MP lens, it offers clear and accurate facial recognition, making it an ideal choice for a variety of environments such as offices, schools, and other facilities requiring stringent access control measures. This terminal supports multiple authentication methods, including face recognition, fingerprint scanning, EM card reading, and PIN entry, ensuring a versatile and adaptable security system that caters to diverse needs. Capable of storing up to 500 face templates, 3,000 cards, and 3,000 fingerprints, the Hikvision DS-K1T321EFWX is designed to handle the demands of high-traffic areas, accommodating up to 150,000 access events. The Hikvision DS-K1T321EFWX Access Control supports both ISAPI and ISUP 5.0 protocols, facilitating seamless integration with other security systems and devices. It can be easily configured through a PC web client or a mobile web client, providing flexibility and convenience for management. The device supports both wired network and Wi-Fi (AP mode) connectivity, allowing for versatile installation options. Additionally, it can be wired with a secure door control unit or card reader via RS-485 for enhanced security. Designed for a wide range of applications, the Hikvision DS-K1T321EFWX Access Control Terminal is well-suited for corporate offices, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, government buildings, and residential complexes. Its comprehensive features and robust capabilities make it an ideal choice for organizations seeking to upgrade their security infrastructure with a reliable and efficient access control solution.

The Dahua NVR5832-EI is a high-performance 32-channel network video recorder (NVR) specifically designed to meet the demands of large-scale surveillance systems. The NVR’s maximum decoding capability is impressive, handling 32 channels of 1080p at 30 frames per second or 32 channels of 2MP at 30 frames per second, providing smooth and detailed video output. With a maximum bandwidth of 384 Mbps for incoming, recording, and outgoing data, the Dahua NVR5832-EI is capable of handling heavy data loads without any performance issues. This makes it well-suited for monitoring high-resolution video feeds from multiple cameras simultaneously. The device supports IP cameras with resolutions up to 32 megapixels, enabling it to deliver ultra-clear footage, which is essential for capturing fine details in security and surveillance applications. The integration of AcuPick technology with support for up to 32 channels further enhances the system's ability to intelligently filter and locate relevant video footage, streamlining the search process for users. The Dahua NVR5832-EI also offers extensive support for data management and storage reliability, with features such as N+M cluster and iSCSI. The iSCSI support allows for centralized storage, which enhances data management efficiency. The Dahua NVR5832-EI supports advanced AI features provided by compatible cameras. These features include face detection and recognition, perimeter protection, SMD Plus, and metadata analysis, which provides valuable information such as object type, speed, and direction. The NVR also supports Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR), which is particularly useful for traffic management and vehicle access control, as well as stereo analysis for behavior analysis in crowded environments. Other AI features include heat mapping, which provides insights into the most active areas of a monitored scene, and people counting, which is useful for understanding crowd flow and enhancing business intelligence.
